about: Boat launches missing from OpenStreetMap, added by hand (alex 2026-10-26: Green Lake had none). Edit by hand: [lat, lon, name, note]. The app adds them to the Boat launches layer with the ones in data/fishing/spots.json.
launches: Ramp and floating pier at the north-east end (Emerald Estates side), off Highway 99, Whistler. You launch into a no-wake zone; waterskiing and float planes in the middle of the lake. Wash your boat before and after (invasive species).
